entries.0a2c1f4dcacf73e4: Companies in Japan and overseas engaged in businesses that use Fintech
entries.153d98b659d6b53a: It is a service that supports requirements definition, system design, business construction and other work in the project execution stage after strategy formulation. In addition to supporting the selection of business partners to build the systems and business mechanisms best suited to each project, it also supports system and business operation after service launch, data utilization and security operations. From the fiscal year ended December 2025, it has also begun providing services in IT risk and PMO support.
entries.974e28c612663162: It is a service that co-creates and supports strategy formulation and business planning with client companies in the upstream phase. It provides high-value support for Fintech challenges such as new business planning, business process reform, system grand design and regulatory compliance, drawing on accumulated know-how and knowledge.
entries.977b87abe89e9c41: Financial Institutions in Payment, Banking, Securities and Insurance
entries.9d4046dce5d29f90: It is the group's single segment, specializing in the payment, banking, securities and insurance fields of Fintech and providing consulting and project execution support. It operates through the company and two consolidated subsidiaries, providing consistent support from strategy formulation through business development to business operations after service launch. It also handles cross-border projects for customers in the Asia-Pacific region, centered on Singapore.
entries.ea95f17a99068e6d: A company that provides consulting and project execution support specialized in the Fintech field, including payments, banking, securities and insurance.
